meta.boundary: Review of five matrix text fields does not prove that all source cards or primary publications preserve every scientific boundary.

rules.to: chronic clinical pain or SCS outcome
rules.prohibited_transfer: Do not treat an acute stimulus or experimental pain classifier score as a chronic-pain severity or treatment-response metric.
rules.required_bridge: A separate patient-linked chronic-pain cohort, prespecified outcome and horizon, participant-disjoint test and calibration are required.

rules.from: Drosophila nociceptive activity or protective behavior
rules.prohibited_transfer: Do not name an animal neural response, withdrawal or rolling score as felt pain intensity.
rules.required_bridge: Report the stimulus, neural response and behavior separately; any human pain endpoint requires a separate human study and its own label.

rules.from: Drosophila connectome dynamics or simulated latent state
rules.to: human spinal recruitment or ECAP waveform
rules.prohibited_transfer: Do not equate fly cells, synapses or simulation states with human spinal anatomy or a recorded ECAP.
rules.required_bridge: Define species-agnostic observables, a physical stimulation/volume-conductor/neural-recruitment observation operator and held-out human comparator tests.

rules.from: ECAP recruitment amplitude, threshold or neural dose
rules.prohibited_transfer: Do not call ECAP a direct pain biomarker or substitute ECAP amplitude for a patient's pain report.
rules.required_bridge: Analyze neural recruitment and pain outcomes as different variables with participant-linked, temporally aligned data and independent validation.

rules.from: ECAP feedback control or accurate dose delivery
rules.prohibited_transfer: Do not infer analgesic efficacy from controller stability or achieved neural dose alone.
rules.required_bridge: Use a prespecified clinical outcome and appropriate comparator; keep the intervention contrast separate from feedback-signal measurement.

rules.prohibited_transfer: Do not count repeated ECAP curves, pulses or longitudinal visits as independent participants or external validation.
rules.required_bridge: Preserve participant IDs, cluster inference by participant and report the participant denominator and disjoint split.

rules.from: multiple reports from one registered SCS trial
rules.prohibited_transfer: Do not count EVOKE 12-, 24- and 36-month reports as three independent trial validations.
rules.required_bridge: Group publications by trial ID and cohort, and identify any separately enrolled replication cohort.

rules.from: animal mechanical-response classes or simulated behavior
rules.prohibited_transfer: Do not transfer animal stimulus classes or simulated actions directly into human analgesic responder labels.
rules.required_bridge: Use a separate human SCS cohort with a validated patient-reported target, follow-up and disjoint evaluation.

rules.prohibited_transfer: Do not describe an intervention-arm difference as a validated preimplant individual response predictor.
rules.required_bridge: Specify baseline predictors and response label, fit without outcome leakage and validate at the patient level in an independent cohort.

rules.from: anatomical map or company simulation demonstration
rules.prohibited_transfer: Do not treat a connectome map, software demo or company announcement as an experimental pain or nociception result.
rules.required_bridge: Identify the exact graph release and separately recorded biological stimulus, neural and behavioral comparator cohorts.
